title: Miscrafted
description: Crafting recipes for items that should already have a recipe.
body:
This Minecraft Mod adds crafting recipes to items that should already have craftability to it. In this mod we add crafting to Totems, Tridents, Saddles  Name Tags, (i know it is in 26.1 but this mod heads towards older versions) God apples, Elytras, and Mob Spawners ( a little off the chart) If you want to see the crafting recipes, go to the Gallery section.



Made with love by - majorkajoryt
